name: appmixer.grok
label: Grok (xAI)
description: xAI Grok API connector. Base URL: https://api.x.ai/v1. API uses Bearer API Key in Authorization header. Common headers: Authorization: Bearer <XAI_API_KEY>, Content-Type: application/json. Models include grok-3-latest, grok-3-fast-latest, grok-3-mini-latest, grok-3-mini-fast-latest, grok-2-latest, grok-2-vision-latest, grok-vision-beta, grok-2-image-latest. Rate limits and quotas vary by model and plan; handle 429 responses with retry/backoff. New users may receive free credits. Obtain API key in xAI Console (https://console.x.ai/team/default/api-keys).
